final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg WHERE ab.peercorr > 0.149 GROUP BY ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist), step2 AS (SELECT ordertypedist, SUM(cnt) as total FROM step1 GROUP BY ordertypedist) SELECT s1.translink, s1.ordertypedist, s1.cnt, CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / s2.total as ratio FROM step1 s1 JOIN step2 s2 ON s1.ordertypedist = s2.ordertypedist ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
